hero.title: Settle the clean claims *automatically*.
hero.line: Insurers and TPAs drown in documents. Newron reads them, checks eligibility against the specific policy, and predicts denial risk — so adjusters focus on the genuine edge cases.

sections.title: Across claims and *underwriting*.
sections.line: Cut handling time on routine claims and surface risk before it becomes a denial or a dispute.

cards.d: Document understanding, eligibility checks and TPA-ready filing that clear clean claims without manual handling.
Predict which claims will bounce, and why, against your historical adjudication data — and fix them first.
Parse proposal forms, medical records and financials to speed up underwriting and reduce leakage.

sections.title: Faster settlements, *fewer* denials.
sections.line: Measured across health and motor lines at insurers and TPAs.

stats.caption: What claims teams see in production

steps.d: All processing runs inside your environment — VPC, on-prem or air-gapped — with full audit logging.
Every eligibility check and denial-risk score is backed by the specific policy clauses and document evidence.
API-first packets and webhooks slot into your existing claims platform and TPA handoffs.
Newron assembles and recommends; adjusters approve. Nothing settles without a person in the loop.

faq.a: Health and motor are in production. Other lines are not validated yet; we scope them case by case rather than claiming coverage up front.
It is trained on your historical adjudication outcomes and explains every prediction with the policy clauses and evidence behind it.

faq.q: Does it fit our TPA workflow?
faq.a: Yes. Newron produces TPA-ready packets and integrates via REST + webhooks with your claims platform and TPA partners.
Processing stays inside your environment with audit logging and data-residency commitments — nothing is sent to third-party model APIs.

cta.title: Replay *last quarter's claims* through Newron.
cta.line: We'll show you the denial-risk and time-to-file numbers on your own historical claims before you commit to anything.
